title: Reseller Addendum Auto-Template and Indemnity Price Adjuster
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Channel and reseller deals routinely require a short reseller addendum that modifies indemnity and liability language from the master MSA/DPA. Sales often delays deals while legal drafts bespoke addenda and negotiates liability caps. We need a lightweight, auditable path that: 1) auto-generates a reseller addendum template populated with customer-specific fields; 2) computes a recommended pricing delta when indemnity/liability deviates from standard terms; 3) allows delegated signers for low-risk partners with audit trail and quick approval gating. Goal: reduce time-to-sign for reseller deals by 40% and decrease legal review touchpoints by 60% for tier-1 reseller requests. Success metrics: median days-to-sign for reseller deals, % of reseller addenda auto-approved, uplift in ARR velocity for reseller-sourced deals. Scope: product-managed template library, pricing adjustment calculator integrated with quoting UI, signatory delegation matrix stored in console, audit log entries surfaced in Contract Ops dashboard. Out of scope: wholesale MSA rewrites or bespoke legal negotiations above indemnity threshold. Proposed approach: - Define canonical reseller addendum variants (standard, limited-indemnity, data-processor addendum) in a Confluence spec. - Build a templating engine to populate fields (company, territory, term, cap delta) and attach PDF/HTML to the quote. - Implement a pricing adjustment engine: simple rule-based model (indemnity multiplier table) initially, with telemetry to iterate to a model-based approach in Q3. - Expose a sales UI: a checkbox in the quote flow to "Request Reseller Addendum" with inline risk score and recommended price delta. - Create delegated signer matrix: roles, thresholds, and an approval webhook for LegalOps. - Audit and analytics: every addendum generation creates structured audit events ingested by Contract Ops dashboards. Risks/Tradeoffs: 1) Rule-based pricing is conservative but easier to approve; risk of mispricing if edge cases not captured. 2) Delegated signing reduces latency but increases need for clear guardrails and periodic audits. 3) Tight coupling with quoting UI requires cross-team coordination with Billing and Sales Ops. Implementation phases: Phase 1 (MVP, this ticket): spec + templates + rule-based price adjuster + quoting UI flag + audit events. Phase 2: A/B pricing experiment and auto-approval flows. Phase 3: ML-assisted pricing suggestions and more granular delegation tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence spec with canonical addendum variants published and approved by Legal (link in artifacts).
Templating engine can produce PDF addendum with correct customer fields for three variant types and attach to quotes.
Pricing adjustment engine returns recommended delta and rationale for simulated 50 recent reseller quotes in staging.
Sales quoting UI exposes the reseller addendum option and shows recommended price delta and a risk summary.
Delegated signer matrix UI stored in Console with at least two roles and webhook to LegalOps mock endpoint.
Audit events emitted on addendum generation, approval, and signing; visible in Contract Ops staging dashboard.
